title: Design System: Dannex Download Manager website

night.purpose: The label's ground: night fields, sheet bands, the rule on stock, selected and stable fills.

night-deep.purpose: Footer ground; the words on Download and on the seal; barcode bars.

head.purpose: The comet's white-hot head: night headlines, the barcode patch, on-night text.

amber.purpose: Frames, sparks, field names and links on night; the seal; focus on night and in dark; Download hover.

ember.purpose: By law the Download action and arrival; also inside the comet's streak gradient and the night headlines' impression.

plum.purpose: The comet's tail; focus on light stock; the crew '+N' hover and the feature arrow hover.

paper-2.purpose: Hover, selected rows, code grounds on stock.

ink-3.purpose: Fine print, field names; IDM's lane in the race.

link.purpose: Links on stock (plum darkened for AA).

night-paper-2.purpose: Hover and selected rows inside night fields (night's paper-2).

paper-dark.purpose: A stock label's face in dark.

paper-2-dark.purpose: Hover and code grounds in dark.

display.purpose: The close's headline; the 404 numeral and poster step numerals share its voice.

hero-headline.purpose: The first viewport's billing, Head on night with the ember impression; width 100%.

page-title.purpose: Inner page titles, on stock or on a night title label.

measure-figure.purpose: The race's ratio in amber; lane times and benchmark values are its smaller steps.

title.purpose: Prose h2; delivery option and theme names.

band.purpose: The night band opening a labelled sheet; the maker's line.

lede.purpose: The line under a section or page head.

field-value.purpose: The measure at the end of a leader row.

field-name.purpose: Field names, column heads, footer and doc-nav group heads, tags. 13px, no caps, no tracking in ar/fa/Indic/Thai/CJK.

shadows.name: shadow-shot
shadows.purpose: Real screenshots and the feature tag laid on its window. The only print element that casts a shadow.

shadows.name: window-on-night
shadows.purpose: The screenshot printed into a night field (hero, title labels).

shadows.name: shadow-menu
shadows.purpose: Pop-ups above the page: split menu, header menu, language sheet, language offer.

shadows.name: night-double-rule
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--amber), inset 0 0 0 6px var(--night), inset 0 0 0 7px color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber) 70%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: The frame of every night field (not a shadow).

shadows.name: go-keyline
shadows.purpose: The printed keyline just inside the Download button.

shadows.name: ember-impression
shadows.purpose: Night headlines printed a hair off register; none in Arabic and Persian.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: Comet fall, seal thunk, button press, dialog in.

motion.name: comet-in
motion.purpose: The comet falls in from 26% up and back, then stops.

motion.name: race
motion.value: real benchmark time, started when seen (IntersectionObserver), replayable
motion.purpose: The lanes' fuse, streak and head (--front, --lit on .lane-track).

motion.name: thunk
motion.purpose: The seal landing on a finished lane.

motion.name: live-fill
motion.purpose: Ours-row's connections fill once on the IDM-alternative roundup, then rest.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: durations .01ms; race shows its finish; tour never advances itself

narrative.overview:
DDM is sold the way a sky-shot firework is: on its printed packet label. The site is that label, offset-printed in the Comet icon's own spot inks (Night, Night deep, Head, Amber, Ember, Plum) on white label stock, so the icon, the installer and the page read as one print job. The persuasive moments (the hero, the contents, the race, the delivery options, the languages, the side-by-side comparison, "built in the open", the close, the download and IDM-alternative title labels, the 404) are night fields: Night ink panels framed in a double amber rule with a four-point spark at each corner. Everything between them is stock, and the labels on stock are white, framed in a night double rule.

The voice is billing: Archivo's width axis expanded and heavy for what sells, plain for what is read, tabular figures for every measure. Facts are printed the way a packet lists its contents, a name at the start and its measure at the end across a dotted leader. Print is flat. Rules and frames separate things; nothing floats, except the real app window (and the feature page's paper tag laid on it), which is a photograph placed on the print and so casts a shadow. The comet itself, three streaks falling into a white-hot head, strikes the real window once on arrival and then rests.

Read pages (help, FAQ, news, legal) take the same world with restraint: the title on stock, one framed stock label to read, night appearing only as small marks (the current doc-nav item, step discs, the crew tag).
keyCharacteristics: Five spot inks from the icon, never a sixth hue; light stock with white labels, night-deep stock with night labels in dark.
Night fields re-map the reading inks locally, so any component printed inside one takes the on-night inks without its own dark variant.
Double rules everywhere a frame is drawn: amber on night, night on stock.
Archivo variable, self-hosted, expanded for billing (wdth 104-122), 100% for reading.
Ember is the Download action and arrival; amber frames and names things on night; plum links on stock.
Flat print, one exception: real screenshots cast a shadow.
States differ by mark (a spark, a fill, a rule, a dash), never by colour alone.

rules.name: The Ember By Law Rule
rules.body: Ember fills only the Download action and arrival. Ticks, tags, "coming soon" stickers, the sponsor heart and every other emphasis print in ink, amber or plum. The comet's own streak gradient may carry ember wherever a transfer is drawn, and the comparison's ours-row fill is the maintainer's recorded exception.

rules.name: The Local Remap Rule
rules.body: A night field never restyles its children. It re-declares ink, ink-2, ink-3, rule, line, link, focus, paper and paper-2 to the on-night inks (amber for rule, link and focus; night for paper), and everything inside follows. A new night surface joins that selector list; it does not get its own colours.

rules.name: The Five Inks Rule
rules.body: No hue outside the icon's five plus their reading tints. A new state is a new mark, not a new colour.

rules.name: The Night Third Rule
rules.body: Night ink holds at least a third of each Persuade page taken as a whole, its fields alternating with stock down the scroll; it is not owed on every screen (the project lead's reading, 2026-11-23). A light-theme stretch of stock between two night fields is fine; darkening every section is not the goal, the light theme stays light. Read pages owe no night beyond their small marks.

rules.name: The Width Carries Rank Rule
rules.body: Rank is billed by width and size, not by colour or by labels stacked above headings. Billing widths are tokens: bill 116%, head-w 110%, field-w 108%; reading is 100%. German, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Dutch, Vietnamese and Indonesian narrow bill to 104% and head-w to 102%; phones (720px and under) narrow them to 106% and 104%.

rules.name: The Script Respect Rule
rules.body: Arabic, Persian, Hindi, Bengali, Thai, Chinese, Japanese and Korean get no tracking and no caps: field names and table heads rise to 13px instead, headings open to 1.35 (1.25 for CJK). Arabic and Persian print the night headlines in register, with no ember impression.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Every number that is a measure uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Only Photos Cast Shadows Rule
rules.body: If it is printed, it is flat. A shadow says "this is a real window laid on the label"; giving one to a card, a band or a heading is a lie about what it is.

dos: **Do** print every persuasive block as a night field (night, 14px, double amber rule, four sparks) and add new night surfaces to the local-remap selector rather than styling their children.
**Do** frame stock labels in a 1.5px night rule with the 1px inner rule; use the single rule only for reading and working frames.
**Do** set facts as leader rows: name at the start, dotted leader, measure end-aligned in tabular figures.
**Do** bill with Archivo's width axis (bill 116%, head-w 110%, field-w 108%) and read at 100%; narrow for the long-word languages and phones as the tokens already do.
**Do** mark states with a shape: the spark on a selected segment or tour window, fill / rule / dash on tags and tick boxes, underline on the current nav item.
**Do** keep night headlines in Head with the ember impression (text-shadow .045em .04em at 80% ember), except in Arabic and Persian.
**Do** keep motion to the grammar: the comet falls in once, the race plays in real time when seen, ours-row fills once; everything else rests, and reduced motion shows every finish.
donts: **Don't** use ember for anything but Download, arrival and the comet's own streak; ticks, tags, "coming soon", the sponsor heart and links never take it.
**Don't** give a shadow to anything printed: cards, bands, headings and labels are flat; only real screenshots, the feature tag laid on its window, and pop-up menus cast one.
**Don't** introduce a hue outside the five inks and their reading tints, or a second typeface for display.
**Don't** track or uppercase Arabic, Persian, Indic, Thai or CJK text; raise it to 13px instead.
**Don't** round frames into pills or soften the 1.5px rules; corners stay die-cut (4 / 6 / 8 / 10 / 14px).
**Don't** put IDM artwork anywhere; IDM is named in text and drawn in neutral ink-3 (its lane, its bars, a lettered mark).
